targets.summary: Tier loop reads tiers[i + 1] without bounding i, so the last tier dereferences undefined.
Balance is read before the awaits and written back after, so concurrent ticks lose updates.
await inside forEach is not awaited, so reserve() returns before any stock is decremented.
Loop bound is <= days, so every window contains one extra day.
discount is optional on the row but dereferenced unguarded, throwing for carts with no coupon.
The final attempt's rejection is swallowed, so retry resolves undefined instead of throwing.
settledAt is a nullable TypeORM column, so an unsettled row loads as null rather than undefined, and isSettled() returns true for every unsettled invoice.
The sweep interval started in the constructor is never cleared on destroy, so the timer keeps the process alive after shutdown.
eligible() returns the inactive suppliers, the exact opposite of what its documentation and name promise. No exception is thrown; the caller sends purchase orders to suspended suppliers.
discount is declared optional on CartRow and dereferenced without a guard, while the equally optional lines is guarded one line above.
The loop bound is <= lastPage, so pageBounds returns one more page than the documented ceil(total / pageSize), and the extra page is empty.
modifiedSince filters on createdAt instead of updatedAt, so an incremental sync silently skips every record that was edited after it was created.
Row permits an absent discount, which is dereferenced without a guard.
The directory Map starts empty; get returns undefined for a missing id, then displayName dereferences name.
The wildcard-exported Row contract permits an absent discount, dereferenced without a guard.
couponFor forwards resolveCoupon, which returns undefined; discount dereferences amount.
Reading converts its input to a string; display calls the numeric toFixed method on that string.
